name: @devdigest/mcp
description: Local-only MCP server (stdio) exposing DevDigest's existing review capabilities — list_agents, run_agent_on_pr, get_findings, get_conventions, get_blast_radius — as a thin façade over the local Fastify API on :3001, no DB/LLM/GitHub access of its own; plus a separate pre-push CLI (`devdigest review --mode working`) that imports @devdigest/reviewer-core in-process, with no server or database required.
